mapper.select: SELECT om.ORDERNUMBER, om.BUILD, om.SPEC, om.CUSTOMER_ADAP, vda.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION, tire.LOAD_INDEX, cha.ACT, admod.VARIABLE FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL vda INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_OM om ON vda.SERIE = om.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = om.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_TIRE_MASTER tire ON vda.TRANS_TS = tire.TRANS_TS LEFT JOIN HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE cha ON vda.SERIE = cha.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = cha.CHNR LEFT JOIN HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION admod ON vda.SERIE = admod.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = admod.CHNO AND admod.STA = '0' WHERE vda.SERIE = #{serie} AND vda.CHNR = #{chnr}
